_about: Ground-truth labels for the 8 real clips (ONE speaker, Chris). Basis = what Chris was instructed to say (NEEDED-RECORDINGS.md) plus whether the engine's 'heard' tone equals the instructed deliberate tone. The audio was NOT re-listened to by a native speaker, so labels are instruction-based, not verified by ear.

tone:1.label: FP
tone:1.basis: Instructed normal; engine heard 3rd tone on 2nd 谢 (expected 4). Caveat: the 2nd syllable of 谢谢 is conventionally neutral, so the engine's expected tone 4 is itself questionable; not verified by ear.

03-xiexie-wrong-tone.intent: 谢谢 with 2nd 谢 rising (xiè xié)

tone:1.label: TP
tone:1.basis: Instructed rising tone on 2nd 谢; engine heard tone 2 = exactly the instructed tone.

tone:2.label: FP
tone:2.basis: Instructed normal; no deliberate change on 欢. Same flag (1->2, score 75.7) also appears in clip 05, so it may be a consistent speaker habit or an engine bias; undetermined without listening.

05-xihuan-zhongwen-wrong-tone.intent: 我喜欢学中文 with 学 falling (xuè) and 中 3rd (zhǒng)

tone:0.label: FP
tone:0.basis: Only 学 and 中 were to be altered; 我 was not (engine heard 1 vs expected 3). Speaker drift while deliberately mangling other tones is possible and unverifiable.

tone:1.label: FP
tone:1.basis: Only 学 and 中 were to be altered; 喜 not (engine heard 2). Same caveat as 我.

tone:2.label: FP
tone:2.basis: Only 学 and 中 were to be altered; 欢 not (engine heard 2, same 1->2 / 75.7 as clip 04).

tone:3.label: TP
tone:3.basis: Instructed falling tone on 学; engine heard tone 4 = instructed.

tone:4.label: TP
tone:4.basis: Instructed 3rd tone on 中; engine heard tone 3 = instructed.

07-silence.intent: room noise only (not silence), reference 你好

08-wrong-sentence.intent: said 你好 while reference was 谢谢

09-omit-xue-middle.intent: 我喜欢学中文 with 学 deliberately OMITTED (said 我喜欢中文; trimmed from clip 04 with ffmpeg)

10-half-only-jintian-tian.intent: 今天天气很好 said only the first half (今天天…; trimmed from clip 06 with ffmpeg)
